This is the planned structure of the chapter, published so the curriculum can be reviewed before the prose is written. Each heading below becomes a section; the last section is what you will build and test. About 75 minutes when written.

18.1 · Environments

tools, state, and episode termination.

18.2 · Credit assignment across turns

outcome rewards, turn-level rewards and masks for tool output.

18.3 · Long rollouts

truncation, context limits, and asynchronous sampling.

18.4 · Environment design

tasks the model can learn from, and hackable rewards to avoid.

What you build

RL on a small tool-use environment, with trajectory-level evaluation. Every number it produces is asserted by a test, and the chapter's companion notebook recomputes it.
